3124.title: Mobile composer touch submission was not reproduced
3124.rootCauseOneLine: Current main prevents coarse-pointer focus transfer and invokes submit before blur; the reported WKWebView-only failure was not reproduced.
3124.proposedFix: Capture the exact TestFlight and iOS event sequence before changing production code.
3124.caveats: The original TestFlight build, phone model, and iOS version were unavailable, and a signed TestFlight WKWebView was not automated.
